issues.article_text: A China completou o voo inaugural do Changying-8, drone de carga de 7 toneladas com alcance de 3.000 km — apresentado como o mais pesado do mundo, com aplicações civis e militares no Mar do Sul da China.
issues.detail: The maiden flight took place on March 31 at Zhengzhou airport, before the edition window opened on April 1 at 10:00 BRT. CGTN and other Chinese outlets reported it on March 31. English-language coverage on April 1 is a delayed report, not a fresh event.
